game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Build a flowchart that reads a and b, adds them, and displays their sum. Test dataset 8: {'a': 8, 'b': 10}; {'a': 0, 'b': 16}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Crater Lake Edge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the smelter using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the smelter is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Rounding Range – Crater Lake Edge Trial
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
